name: Induced Subgraph Distraction
description: The problem asks for a connected induced subgraph containing specific vertices. On a tree, this is simply the Steiner subtree. By explicitly warning the solver that adding vertices automatically includes ALL edges between them (the definition of an induced subgraph), we bait the LLM into treating it as a complex constraint-satisfaction problem, fearing "extra" edges, even though the unique-path tree property guarantees no such extra edges exist.
